entities.name: PMID:15474446
observations: Cohort of 176 patients with palpable breast cysts; thick wall, mural tumor, eccentric mass, and internal septae predicted neoplasm; cyst aspiration had frequent recurrence.

entities.name: Benign complicated cyst
observations: Thin-walled cystic breast lesion with internal echoes but no solid component lacks major suspicious sonographic features; in an asymptomatic patient, surveillance rather than aspiration or biopsy is appropriate.
